log.title: Kickflip, still pending
log.body: Both are still in the practice phase. The Kickflip will arrive on its own schedule. In the meantime, repetition is the whole method.

log.title: Say it again, slower
log.body: Reading documentation is comfortable. Saying the same thought out loud, without rehearsing it first, is the part that still needs work. So I practice saying it badly and then saying it again.

log.title: A log, not a feed
log.body: No daily posting, no scores, no quantified self. Just short entries when there is something worth keeping — a trick, a trip, a sentence that finally came out right.
